summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Next Day Disclosure Return under HKSE rules via Form 6-K reporting on its ongoing share buyback program. The filing details multiple repurchase transactions from late March through mid-April 2026, with daily purchases ranging from ~350k to ~760k shares at prices between USD 6.56 and USD 7.14 per share. Shares repurchased have not yet been cancelled and are held as treasury. The buyback reduces the issuer's outstanding share count, returning capital to shareholders. The filing is a routine disclosure of open-market repurchases; no tender offer or special meeting is involved. This is an issuer-driven capital return event.
